query: SELECT i.id FROM chat_invocations i JOIN agents a ON a.id=i.agent_id JOIN chat_runs r ON r.id=i.run_id WHERE i.status='pending' AND chat_channel_run_allowed(i.agent_id,i.thread_id,r.source_identity_id,r.channel_origin) AND a.deployment_mode='gateway' AND NOT a.paused AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 50;
